function.name: system_status
function.description: Read daemon, host API, generation, and isolated data directory status.

function.name: system_doctor
function.description: Inspect the isolated runtime layout, local transport, ownership, and writeability.

function.name: games_list
function.description: List explicit game definitions and registered installations without discovery side effects.

function.name: profiles_list
function.description: List profiles for an explicit game without creating or activating one.

function.name: profiles_contentState
function.description: Read authoritative Profile content availability and transient download overlays without mutating Library data.

function.name: profiles_create
function.description: Create and explicitly initialize a profile for one game.

function.name: profiles_update
function.description: Update profile metadata using an explicit profile and revision.

function.name: profiles_activate
function.description: Activate an explicit profile only within its explicit game.

function.name: profiles_delete
function.description: Delete one explicit profile without implicitly activating another.

function.name: profiles_clone
function.description: Clone one revision-bound profile configuration with stable group and list order.

function.name: groups_list
function.description: List the ordered group tree for one explicit profile.

function.name: groups_create
function.description: Create a group at an explicit sibling position.

function.name: groups_update
function.description: Rename or expand one revision-bound group.

function.name: groups_move
function.description: Move a group to an explicit parent and first-wins sibling position.

function.name: groups_delete
function.description: Delete a leaf group while preserving at least one group and its mod associations.

function.name: mods_list
function.description: List a specific profile snapshot with bound opaque pagination.

function.name: mods_get
function.description: Read one safe profile-mod projection and its known versions.

function.name: mods_rename
function.description: Rename shared mod metadata with explicit shared scope and entity revision.

function.name: mods_setEnabled
function.description: Enable or disable one explicit profile association.

function.name: mods_setEnabledBatch
function.description: Atomically enable or disable a deduplicated explicit association set.

function.name: mods_move
function.description: Move one association to an explicit group and first-wins position.

function.name: mods_remove
function.description: Remove only the explicit profile association, retaining shared metadata and content.

function.name: mods_cleanupMissing
function.description: Remove missing local associations from one explicit game and profile.

function.name: mods_setVersion
function.description: Resolve an exact version plan, then atomically apply it to a Profile or cache its verified artifact.

function.name: jobs_get
function.description: Read a durable job snapshot after timeout, restart, or reconnect.

function.name: jobs_watch
function.description: Read retained events after a per-job sequence cursor, with snapshot reset metadata.

function.name: jobs_cancel
function.description: Request cancellation; the returned job state remains authoritative.

function.name: actions_get
function.description: Read a durable action and its immutable approval binding.

function.name: modules_inspect
function.description: Inspect a module manifest and its resolved lifecycle state.

function.name: install_plan
function.description: Build and verify an immutable deploy plan for an explicit profile snapshot.

function.name: sources_search
function.description: Execute sources.search through the authoritative Application service.

function.name: mods_add
function.description: Execute mods.add through the authoritative Application service.

function.name: settings_get
function.description: Execute settings.get through the authoritative Application service.

function.name: mods_pack
function.description: Execute mods.pack through the authoritative Application service.

function.name: proxy_status
function.description: Read actual daemon-owned proxy readiness and leased service identity.

function.name: proxy_start
function.description: Start verified signed proxy service; pin actual artifact and protocol until stop.

function.name: proxy_stop
function.description: Stop owned leased child with its startup protocol, including revoked versions.

function.name: proxy_privilege
function.description: Request a separate durable approval for CA credentials, trust, system hosts, or privileged listen authorization.
